description: Published response-detection rules, reproduced to the letter. A field whose value the primary paper does not state is null and listed in 'unspecified': the rule refuses to run until the user supplies it.

vanblooijs2023.hint: the ER-detect default baseline search epoch is (-1.0, -0.1) s; the published code's reading is the rule 'vanblooijs2023_code'
vanblooijs2023.source: van Blooijs et al. 2023, Nat Neurosci (ds004080)
vanblooijs2023.notes: The registry row of spec §5.6 as written: |x| > 3.4 SD of the baseline with a negative peak, at least one sample, in 9-100 ms; the peak is the most negative sample of the window (the paper's description), measured from the baseline mean, with no SD floor. The published code's reading (50 uV SD floor, local minima, first sample excluded, saturation) is the rule 'vanblooijs2023_code'.

vanblooijs2023_code.source: van Blooijs et al. 2023, Nat Neurosci (ds004080); code: mnl_ccepAge ccep_detect_n1peak_ECoG.m
vanblooijs2023_code.notes: The published code to the letter: SD over (-2.0, -0.1) s (in the published pipeline, of an average whose trials had their median over (-1.0, -0.1) s removed) with a floor of 50 uV; local minima found with a selectivity of 20 uV (peakfinder) searched from the first sample after 9 ms to the first after 500 ms, the first sample excluded, kept up to the first sample after 100 ms, the minimum of largest magnitude chosen, measured from the baseline median, refused above 3000 uV (saturation) or when every minimum is positive (a positive-valued minimum is otherwise accepted on its magnitude, as in the code).

hays2021.hint: a pre-stimulus window, for example (-0.5, -0.05) s

silverstein2020.hint: a pre-stimulus window, for example (-0.5, -0.05) s

ftract.hint: F-TRACT uses Z thresholds between 3 and 7; set k, and max_peak_delay=0.2 for the optional peak-delay cut
ftract.source: Lemarechal et al. 2022, Brain (F-TRACT); Trebaul et al. 2018

prime2020.hint: the paper states neither the detection threshold nor the baseline
